title: When death seems to wait for or miss the family witness

source_packet.source_basis: Public-source synthesis for schema testing; no private testimony, no contributor interview, no claim of corpus completeness.
limitations: Public sources describe recognized patterns but do not supply firsthand room texture.
The record must not be used to diagnose, time, or manage a particular death.
Treatment, legal, ritual, and emergency decisions remain local and must be handled by qualified teams or relevant authorities.

moment.plain_scene: A family may feel that the person waited for someone to arrive, woke to say goodbye, or died just after everyone stepped out; the room then has to hold grief, relief, guilt, or a sense of pattern without knowing why.
ordinary_language_queries: died when I left the room
waited until we arrived to die
did my mom choose when to die
woke up to say goodbye then died

content_layers.observation_text: A public family-facing source acknowledges that people often tell stories of someone appearing to wait for a relative, wake to say goodbye, or die when others have briefly left, while stressing that it is impossible to know why a person dies at a precise moment.
content_layers.source_synthesis: Marie Curie supports this as a meaning-and-guilt record rather than a physiology claim; it remains single-source and highly interpretive.

interpretation.editor_interpretation: This record exists to prevent the corpus from either sentimentalizing or debunking the story. The human fact is the wound: “I was there” or “I missed it.”

what_this_is_not: not proof that the dying person deliberately chose or rejected a witness
not a claim of physiological control over timing
not a reason for family blame
uncertainties: This is currently a single-source public pilot.
Future records must separate bedside narrative, bereavement meaning, and clinical claims.
Cultures differ in how they understand presence, permission, and timing.
content_layers.lay_orientation: A lay surface should meet guilt directly: leaving the room does not mean failure, and the exact reason a person dies when they do is usually unknowable.
content_layers.practitioner_notes: A practitioner surface should collect how workers comfort families who missed the moment without imposing a story.
language_notes: Never write as if the archive knows intention.

provenance.provenance_statement: Drafted from named public sources to test the v2 witnessed-moment schema. It should be reviewed before any public surface uses it.

safety.clinical_boundary: This record is observational/source-indexing only. It is not medical advice, not a prognosis, and not a substitute for a local hospice, clinician, emergency, legal, cultural, or care team.
safety.safety_notes: Before public use, route through clinical safety review and ensure any lay surface directs urgent or worried readers to qualified local support.
